prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production playable environment background for an isometric action RPG, exactly 1536x1024 pixels, landscape 3:2.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate an entirely NEW distinct environment; do not copy the reference layout.
Style/medium: premium richly painted action RPG environment reminiscent of Torchlight 2 and Nine Parchments; polished hand-painted bitmap, textured brushwork, beautiful real form and architectural depth, weathered stone, turquoise glazing and aged copper. Not pixel art, not vector art, not photorealistic, not a 3D render.
World: a climate-flooded future city repurposed by mages.
Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter top-down orthographic game camera. Compose the entire connected walkable area clearly within frame; minimal sky, scenery around outer edges only. The hero is added later, so floors must remain visible.
Gameplay layout rules: bottom-center entrance touches the lower image edge and connects continuously to every pocket of the level. All walkable floor is one identical playable elevation, with NO stairs, split levels, ramps, sunken courts or raised platforms. Architectural vertical depth belongs only outside the playable floor. Spacious connected pockets and at least two readable route loops, with all connecting passages at least 120 pixels wide in the 1536-pixel-wide image. No maze, no narrow passages. Cut away foreground walls to ankle height; keep other walls low enough that a small hero on the floor cannot be hidden. Large unobstructed middles, architectural and environmental props clustered only at outer margins. Floor should fill most of the image, with varied plausible room or terrace shapes rather than a plain arena.
Avoid: people, characters, enemies, animals, UI, text, lettering, numbers, glyphs, runes, logos, watermarks, center-placed gameplay objects, loot chests, collision-blocking props in walkable middles, tall foreground structures, intact roofs hiding playable floors.
Primary request: lush elevated urban rooftop gardens at a blue-golden morning. A broad pale weathered stone terrace loop links four generously sized connected pockets: west greenhouse garden court, north glass courtyard, east rainwater garden, and the bottom-center entry court. The playable loop is broad and coplanar, with open sightlines through every connection. Add terracotta planters at outer edges, cutaway open-sided turquoise/copper greenhouse structures around the west and north perimeter, giant flowering trees planted at the rear outer perimeter with their foliage extending OUTSIDE the playable floor, lush vines and flowers framing the terrace. The east rainwater garden has narrow water features tucked along the outer edge, leaving a broad clear stone court. Flooded ruined city and deep blue canals are visible beyond the outer rooftop edges; the rooftop height is suggested by outside building facades only. A beautiful safe outdoor exploration zone with organic, varied spacious courts, no stairs anywhere. Morning sunlight on warm stone, blue shadow, rich botanical color. No tall tree or greenhouse obstruction over the walkable floor.
